request: Build a small headless Jac API for one person's scheduled Pomodoro sessions. An event stores its date, title, work and break lengths, and number of work cycles. Starting a timer makes any earlier active session done. A session begins in work cycle zero; advancing it alternates work and break, then marks it done after its final work cycle. Let the user read and change a persistent idle message. Keep graph data and public functions in endpoints.jac, and register them from main.jac. Include tests for the session transitions and settings behavior.
acceptance: A new session retires the previous active one.
For an event with two work cycles, advance_phase produces break[0], work[1], then done.
get_settings and set_idle_text use one persistent Settings node.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and an API-only project; no JSX, browser UI, or external AI service.
Reconstruct the scoped behavior of Rui/pomodoro endpoints.jac; keep public function names and fields grounded in that source.
